crew.overview: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, seven disillusioned castoffs must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.
crew.title: Thunderbolts*

details.biography:
Joanna Calo is an American writer, director and producer. She is known for her work on the television series Hacks and BoJack Horseman and being the co-showrunner of The Bear and co-writer of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) film Thunderbolts* (2025).

She has won three Writers Guild of America Awards, an Independent Spirit Award, and a Producers Guild Award. She has been nominated for four Primetime Emmy Awards.

She and her husband have two children. They live in Los Angeles, California.
